about.title: Domberg Construction
about.p1: Domberg is a team that has been building stylish and reliable block houses in Kaliningrad and the region for over 10 years. We don’t just build houses — we create thoughtful living spaces. Every project is a blend of architectural aesthetics, engineering precision, and modern comfort.
about.p2: We support clients at every stage — from choosing a plot to moving into a finished home. If you're looking for a partner you can trust with your future home — we're here.
about.p3: Domberg — homes you'll love to live in.

PropertyManagement.title: Property Management in Kaliningrad
PropertyManagement.p1: The perfect solution for owners living abroad. Our team handles everything — from finding tenants and managing payments to legal and tax support.
PropertyManagement.p2: Rent out your property profitably and hassle-free. We manage everything — you earn income.
PropertyManagement.p3: Property management — your home, our responsibility.
PropertyManagement.servicesText: We take care of the full cycle of property management. From listing creation and guest communication to cleaning, laundry, supply restocking and price optimization. You receive stable income — without extra worries.

insurance.title: Property Insurance
insurance.text: Upon request, we arrange property insurance against fire, flooding, theft and other risks. We handle all communication with the insurance company.

owner_support.title: Owner Communication
owner_support.text: We stay in touch via Telegram, WhatsApp, or Email. You receive photo reports, updates on events, and always stay informed — no matter where you are.

emergency.title: Emergency Response
emergency.text: We handle all emergencies — from leaks to lock issues. We act quickly and in the owner's best interest.

furnishing.title: Furnishing and Equipment
furnishing.text: We help furnish and equip your rental: purchase, delivery, assembly, textile and appliance selection.

foreign_payment.title: International Payments
foreign_payment.text: We accept payments to foreign accounts — convenient for owners living outside Russia. Transfers in euros, dollars, and other currencies are supported.

legal_support_germany.title: Legal Support in Germany
legal_support_germany.text: We partner with a legal firm in Germany. Contracts can be arranged and signed through them — convenient and secure for EU-based owners.

members.name: Tenant selection and check-in
members.role: We select reliable tenants, verify documents, draw up contracts, and organize turnkey move-ins.

members.name: Property condition control
members.role: We maintain regular control of the property condition, promptly fix issues, and keep the property in excellent shape.

members.name: Cleaning and maintenance
members.role: We ensure cleaning, fix breakdowns, and monitor the technical condition of the property.

members.name: Legal and financial support
members.role: We handle contracts, track income and expenses, and resolve legal and tax issues.

members.name: 24/7 tenant support
members.role: We respond promptly to tenant requests and handle any household or technical issues 24/7.

members.name: Reports and payouts
members.role: We provide complete financial reports and make timely payouts to the property owner.

land.title: Land selection and house construction in Kaliningrad and the region
land.p1: We will help you select and purchase a land plot in a convenient location, and also build a house of any complexity — according to your wishes and turnkey.
land.p2: Our company provides full-cycle construction — from preparing project documentation to putting the house into operation. We take care of the entire process and implement projects of any complexity.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: This privacy policy outlines the procedure for processing and protecting users' personal data when using the 'Domberg' website (hereinafter referred to as the Operator).

section1.title: General provisions
section1.text: Using the website implies the user's agreement with this privacy policy. If you do not agree, you should refrain from using the site.

section2.title: Personal data
section2.text: Personal data refers to information provided voluntarily by the user via the site form: name, phone number, and comment. This data is not shared with third parties without the user’s consent.

section3.title: Purpose of data collection
list: Contacting clients to clarify request details.

section4.title: Methods of processing
section4.text: Personal data is processed both manually and automatically in accordance with the laws of the Russian Federation.

section5.title: Storage and protection
section5.text: Data is stored in secure Google services (Google Sheets) and is not accessible to third parties. Transfer is carried out via secure HTTPS connection. Notifications are sent through a Telegram bot.

section6.title: Retention period
section6.text: Data is stored for 12 months from the date of receipt or until the user requests its deletion.

section7.title: Third-party disclosure
section7.text: The operator does not transfer personal data to third parties except as required by law.

section8.title: User rights
section8.text: The user has the right to request correction or deletion of their data and may withdraw consent by contacting via email:

section9.title: Policy updates
section9.text: The operator reserves the right to update this policy without the user’s consent. The latest version is always available at: /PrivacyPolicy
